decision: Memory is a continuity layer, not an AIDY source of truth. Runtime/data/source repo evidence overrides Memory.
reason: Prevent stale AI context from becoming production truth.

decision: Keep AIDY formal-forward authority OFF unless explicitly graduated with evidence and owner approval.
reason: Research/decision infrastructure must not silently acquire real-money authority.

decision: Day 6 will implement bounded archive retry/backoff and explicit dead-letter handling, preserving capture independence and evidence truth.
reason: Day 5 made poison/backlog visible but intentionally avoided a pre-open schema/runtime mutation.

decision: Provider identity/style/behaviour history is owned and versioned append-only in Super Signals; AIDY remains the separate point-in-time market/context truth service.
reason: Provider knowledge must be reconstructable without duplicating provider state into AIDY or giving research broker authority.
source: Super Signals migration 0056_provider_profile_versions and live production verification

decision: Historical/forward provider research may use only an immutable provider profile version effective at or before the signal timestamp; unverifiable pre-Day-7 provider research remains legacy_unresolvable and cannot become PIT-clean score evidence.
reason: Prevent hindsight leakage from current/future provider knowledge into historical evaluation before joining provider setups to AIDY context.
source: Super Signals migration 0057_provider_pit_boundary; PR #141; production Postgres verification

decision: AIDY production runtime and health recovery must not depend on GitHub Actions availability. During the temporary Actions credit outage, use trusted external exact-SHA acceptance and preserve the intent of branch protections rather than repeatedly rerunning unavailable CI.
reason: The owner confirmed GitHub Actions credits are exhausted for about one week and failed required checks showed 0 ms runner execution, while AIDY needs continuous weekday operation.

decision: AIDY decisions must be persisted immutably with the exact PIT-safe evidence available at decision time and later scored against a fixed counterfactual baseline. The primary success metric is factual decision delta: money made/saved or money lost because AIDY intervened.
reason: The owner requires AIDY to become measurably better at approving, denying, holding, conflicting and closing trades, not merely produce narrative confidence or hindsight analysis.

decision: AIDY must maintain conditional provider intelligence and a persistent hypothesis/question registry covering direction, session, regime, volatility/liquidity proxies, management quality, TP progression, duplicates, latency, agreement/conflict, adverse duration and recovery behaviour; insufficient evidence must resolve to unknown.
reason: Provider quality is conditional and multidimensional; one overall win rate cannot support safe decision authority.

decision: Once Provider Context is healthy, generate shadow decisions for every eligible Super Signals trade and graduate decision authority by class rather than all at once: deterministic duplicate rejection first, then obvious exposure conflicts, then provider/regime denies, then early-close management and broader authority. Every class requires a kill switch, audit trail, prospective evidence and explicit owner/live gate.
reason: The owner wants AIDY making smart decisions very soon, while preserving factual learning, reversibility and the existing live-risk boundary.
